explanation: In Russia, beckoning someone with your finger is generally perceived as rude and dismissive, akin to calling a dog. It is associated with a lack of respect and is rarely used in polite or formal interactions.
local_tip: Instead, use a palm-down hand gesture with all fingers moving together to beckon someone politely.

also_check.note: Beckoning with the index finger is considered very rude and is used only for animals.
This gesture is highly offensive and can be seen as a challenge or insult.
While common in casual settings, it can be seen as condescending in formal or professional contexts.
